description: Change the signed-in member's profile settings. Send only what should change: firstName, lastName, bio (up to 500 characters), location, website, pronouns; profileIsPublic (false makes the profile private); eventsVisibility ("public" or "private"); commentsEmailReplies (email me when someone replies); pinnedGameIds (up to 4 game ids in order, replacing the current pins; [] clears them). Username and password changes are on the website only. Returns the settings as saved. Acts on the caller's own Kineticist account (the signed-in member, or the API key owner). Agents that make many calls per task use up a free account's daily allowance quickly.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

items.description: Game UUID. Accepts both the raw UUID and the 'gm_'-prefixed form that get_game_details returns (prefix stripped automatically).

name: kineticist_update_profile_settings
